WITH combination_avgs AS (
    SELECT
        s.transref,
        t.tradekind,
        AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
        ON s.transref = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader AS t
        ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
with_baseline AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(avg_optvolrt) OVER () AS baseline
    FROM combination_avgs
),
with_deviation AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        avg_optvolrt - baseline AS deviation
    FROM with_baseline
    WHERE baseline IS NOT NULL
),
with_type_avg AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
    FROM with_deviation
),
kept AS (
    SELECT
        tradekind,
        avg_optvolrt,
        deviation,
        deviation - type_avg_deviation AS excess
    FROM with_type_avg
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
      AND deviation > type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt,
    AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
    AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: The equally weighted baseline averages the per-combination option volume averages; SQL AVG ignores combinations whose average is NULL.
